{{Top}}
A '''protein cube''' was a concentrated [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] product that was high in various proteins. They were often used as part of field rations for [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and other warriors.
